description.en: Agent tools for the Unity 2022.3 Editor. Host this file anywhere over HTTPS and add its URL as an index source in DSH (Plugins -> Discover -> Index sources), or pass it to the plugin_market tool.
description.zh: 把 Unity 2022.3 编辑器交给 agent。把这个文件放在任意 HTTPS 地址，然后在 DSH 的“插件 → 发现 → 索引源”里加上它的 URL，或直接传给 plugin_market 工具。

description.en: Drive the Unity 2022.3 Editor from the agent: scene hierarchy, GameObjects, components, serialized properties, Play mode, console logs, screenshots, builds and C# eval, through a self-installing loopback bridge package.
description.zh: 让 agent 直接操作 Unity 2022.3 编辑器：场景层级、GameObject、组件、序列化属性、Play 模式、控制台日志、截图、构建与 C# 求值，桥接包会自动装进工程。
